summary: LUNAR GATE is a scientific and technological project that aims to determine the most suitable region for establishing a permanent base and space launch center on the Moon where people can live for a long time
details: 1. What is the purpose of our project? The aim of our project is to find the most suitable location for a permanent human settlement by studying different regions of the Moon with scientific data. We are especially focused on the South Pole of the Moon. Because in this region: - There are high areas that receive sunlight for a long time. - There is a possibility of water ice in craters that are constantly in shadow. - Water can be used for drinking water and oxygen production. - There are areas where solar energy can be used. However, not every point of the South Pole is suitable for living or setting up a launch center. Therefore, we aim to compare different regions and determine the most favorable area.
